title: Abaqophi Bamatshe Besigodi Sasendulo
intro: Cabanga ngempucuko eyavela ezigodini zamatshe zase-Arabia, enekhono lokuqopha izindlu ezinhle kakhulu ezintabeni. Bachuma ngamandla nangobuciko, kodwa indaba yabo iphawuleka ngokudelela okuthusayo isixwayiso saphezulu. Njengoba uhlola indaba yabo, uzothola abantu abazikhukhumezayo abaholela ekubhujisweni kwabo ngokuphelele. Babengobani?
clues: Sazuza ifa lezwe elinamathafa anamatshe namawa amakhulu, lapho sakha khona izindlu zethu ngobuchule obungenakuqhathaniswa.
Sasidume ngokuqopha izindlu eziphephile ezintabeni, sizizwa siphephile kunoma yikuphi ukulimala.
Isithunywa seza kithi sivela phakathi kwethu, sisikhumbuza ngomusa ka-Allah futhi sisixwayisa ngesijeziso.
Safuna isibonakaliso, kwaphuma ikamela lensikazi eliyisimangaliso edwaleni, isivivinyo esicacile esivela ku-Allah.
Sasilalela isixwayiso futhi sanquma ikamela lensikazi, sahleka usulu isithunywa futhi saphikisa isijeziso.
Ukuqhuma okukodwa kwasifica emakhaya ethu, kwathi ekuseni salala phansi, sengathi asikaze sihlale lapho.
verse: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast]. (69:5)
